name: 何孟珣
objective:
本課程旨在引導學生從「生活型態」與「人類行為」的視角切入設計創新。課程將帶領學生透過實際的田野調查、深度訪談與問卷分析，洞察當代與未來的生活型態趨勢。學生將學習如何將這些洞察轉化為具體的設計提案，創造符合新興生活型態的產品、服務或體驗系統。課程最終以專案形式呈現，主題涵蓋「每日的數位排毒」、「都市遊牧世代」以及「永續的共享生活」等前瞻性生活型態。透過本課程，期望培養學生敏銳的社會觀察力、扎實的使用者研究能力，以及將行為洞察轉化為創新設計的實踐力。
This course aims to guide students in approaching design innovation from the perspectives of lifestyle and human behavior. The course will lead students through practical field research, in-depth interviews, and questionnaire analysis
to gain insights into contemporary and future lifestyle trends. Students will learn how to translate these insights into concrete design proposals, creating products,services, or experience systems that align with emerging lifestyles. The course
culminates in a final project covering forward-looking lifestyle themes such as"Daily Digital Detox," "Urban Nomad Generation," and "Sustainable Shared
Living." Through this course, we expect to cultivate students' acute social observation skills, solid user research abilities, and the practical capability to transform behavioral insights into innovative designs.

scorePolicy:
1. 生活型態調查練習 (20%)：針對特定族群進行田野調查、訪談或問卷，產出生活型態洞察報告。
2. 期中概念提案 (30%)：基於前期的調查結果與行為設計理論，提出針對特定生活型態的初步設計概念與行為介入策略。
3. 期末專案發表 (40%)：發展完整的「新日常生活」設計專案（主題三擇一：每日的數位排毒、都市遊牧世代、永續的共享生活），包含產品/服務原型與體驗旅程。
4. 心得報告 (10%)：最後兩週搜尋「新的生活型態/行為設計」有關的影片（最好不要是課程提到的三種），觀看並撰寫 1 頁 A4 的心得報告。

1. Lifestyle Research Exercise (20%): Conduct field research, interviews, or questionnaires targeting specific groups to produce a lifestyle insight report.
2. Midterm Concept Proposal (30%): Based on preliminary research results and behavioral design theories, propose an initial design concept and behavioral intervention strategy for a specific lifestyle.
3. Final Project Presentation (40%): Develop a complete "New Daily Life" design project (choose one of three themes: Daily Digital Detox, Urban Nomad Generation, Sustainable Shared Living), including a product/service prototype and an experience journey.
4. Reflection Report (10%): Watch videos related to new lifestyles/behavioral design during the last two weeks and write a 2-page A4 reflection report.
materials:
本課程無指定教科書，將提供各週主題的相關閱讀材料。以下為建議的參考書目：
There is no designated textbook for this course. Relevant reading materials for weekly topics will be provided. The following are recommended references:

1. Eyal, N. (2014). Hooked: How to Build Habit-Forming Products. Portfolio.
2. Duhigg, C. (2012). The Power of Habit: Why We Do What We Do in Life and Business. Random House.
3. Norman, D. (2013). The Design of Everyday Things: Revised and Expanded Edition. Basic Books.
4. Kahneman, D. (2011). Thinking, Fast and Slow. Farrar, Straus and Giroux.
5. Thaler, R. H. & Sunstein, C. R. (2008). Nudge: Improving Decisions About Health, Wealth, and Happiness. Yale University Press.
6. IDEO. (2015). The Field Guide to Human-Centered Design. IDEO.org.
